title: Merab Dvalishvili Was Hit From Behind Mid-Interview. When Is Enough Enough?
yt_title: Merab Dvalishvili Attacked in Abu Dhabi: When Is Enough?

slides.label: Abu Dhabi
slides.text: During an RAF interview, video shows *Usman Nurmagomedov* approaching *Merab Dvalishvili* from behind and *slapping* him.

slides.label: The brawl
slides.text: Footage shows *four men vs two*: Merab and *21-year-old* wrestler *Saba Lazishvili*. Merab says he was kicked while down.

slides.label: The aftermath
slides.text: Those involved were taken to a *police station* for statements. Merab's Saturday match is *in doubt*.

slides.label: The root
slides.text: In *July in Tbilisi*, video shows *Merab* striking a man from Umar Nurmagomedov's circle. Makhachev: "Why were you silent?"

slides.label: The pattern
slides.text: From *UFC 229* to Abu Dhabi, grudges keep spilling *outside the cage*. Punishments keep arriving *too small*.

slides.label: Higher standard
slides.text: Trained fighters *know what their hands do*. That standard applies to *everyone*, Usman *and* Merab.

cta_line: Honor is *keeping your hands down outside the cage*.
question: Should fighters face tougher penalties for fights outside the cage?
